answer: Recursive State Divergence Tax To register, an agent deposits funds into an isolated ledger segment called a terrace. Operating a clone cluster on the atlas requires redundant computation that exceeds the yield of parallel execution. The attacker pays a mandatory divergence penalty in sable tokens whenever twin output similarity crosses the correlation threshold, making marginal scaling strictly negative-EV.
